method: Original SQLite engine and independent native PostgreSQL 16.6; every original record loaded. This is an oracle, not the mixed-source product test.

postgresql.sql: SELECT t2.driverref FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t1.raceid = 20 ORDER BY t1.q1 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE q.raceid = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.q2, d.driverid LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT t2.name FROM circuits AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t2.circuitid = t1.circuitid WHERE t1.country = 'Germany'
SELECT DISTINCT t1.lat, t1.lng FROM circuits AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t2.circuitid = t1.circuitid WHERE t2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
SELECT DISTINCT t1.lat, t1.lng FROM circuits AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t2.circuitid = t1.circuitid WHERE t2.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
SELECT t1.q1 FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t1.raceid = 354 AND t2.forename = 'Bruno' AND t2.surname = 'Senna'
SELECT t2.number FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t1.raceid = 903 AND t1.q3 LIKE '1:54%'

SELECT COUNT(t3.driverid) FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE t1.year = 2007 AND t1.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND t2.time IS NULL

SELECT t1.forename, t1.surname FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t2.raceid = 592 AND NOT t2.time IS NULL AND NOT t1.dob IS NULL ORDER BY t1.dob ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT t2.forename, t2.surname, t2.url FROM laptimes AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t1.raceid = 161 AND t1.time LIKE '1:27%'
SELECT DISTINCT t1.lat, t1.lng FROM circuits AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t2.circuitid = t1.circuitid WHERE t2.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
SELECT t2.url FROM constructorresults AS t1 INNER JOIN constructors AS t2 ON t2.constructorid = t1.constructorid WHERE t1.raceid = 9 ORDER BY t1.points DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
SELECT t2.code FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t1.raceid = 45 AND t1.q3 LIKE '1:33%'
SELECT t2.url FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN seasons AS t2 ON t2.year = t1.year WHERE t1.raceid = 901
SELECT t1.forename, t1.surname FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t2.raceid = 872 AND NOT t2.time IS NULL ORDER BY t1.dob DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
SELECT t1.nationality FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid ORDER BY CAST(t2.fastestlapspeed AS DOUBLE PRECISION) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(value AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM (SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.raceid = 853 THEN CAST(t2.fastestlapspeed AS DECIMAL) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t2.raceid = 854 THEN CAST(t2.fastestlapspeed AS DECIMAL) ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.raceid = 853 THEN CAST(t2.fastestlapspeed AS DECIMAL) ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t1.forename = 'Paul' AND t1.surname = 'di Resta') AS measured(value)

columns: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.time IS NOT NULL THEN T2.driverId END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / COUNT(T2.driverId)

postgresql.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT t2.time IS NULL THEN t2.driverid END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t2.driverid), 0) FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid WHERE t1.date = '1983-07-16'

SELECT name FROM races WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) FROM races ORDER BY date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) = (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) FROM races ORDER BY date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1)

SELECT t3.forename, t3.surname, t2.points FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN driverstandings AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid ORDER BY t2.points DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT t2.milliseconds, t1.forename, t1.surname, t3.name FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN laptimes AS t2 ON t1.driverid = t2.driverid INNER JOIN races AS t3 ON t2.raceid = t3.raceid ORDER BY t2.milliseconds ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(value AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM (SELECT AVG(t2.milliseconds) FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN laptimes AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE t3.forename = 'Lewis' AND t3.surname = 'Hamilton' AND t1.year = 2009 AND t1.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix') AS measured(value)

columns: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.position <> 1 THEN T2.position END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / COUNT(T2.driverStandingsId)

postgresql.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.position <> 1 THEN t2.position END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t2.driverstandingsid), 0) FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN driverstandings AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE t3.surname = 'Hamilton' AND t1.year >= 2010

SELECT t1.forename, t1.surname, t1.nationality, MAX(t2.points) FROM drivers AS t1 INNER JOIN driverstandings AS t2 ON t2.driverid = t1.driverid WHERE t2.wins >= 1 GROUP BY t1.forename, t1.surname, t1.nationality ORDER BY COUNT(t2.wins) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST('2026-10-04 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dob) AS BIGINT) AS age, forename, surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT r.name, c.name, c.location FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2005 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.date) = 9

SELECT t1.name FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN driverstandings AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE t3.forename = 'Alex' AND t3.surname = 'Yoong' AND t2.position < 20

SELECT t1.name, t1.year FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN laptimes AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE t3.forename = 'Michael' AND t3.surname = 'Schumacher' ORDER BY t2.milliseconds ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name, s.points FROM races AS r JOIN driverstandings AS s ON s.raceid = r.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = s.driverid WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY r.date, r.round, r.raceid LIMIT 1

columns: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.country = 'Germany' THEN T2.circuitID END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / COUNT(T2.circuitId)

postgresql.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.country = 'Germany' THEN t2.circuitid END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t2.circuitid), 0) FROM circuits AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t2.circuitid = t1.circuitid WHERE t2.name = 'European Grand Prix'
SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit'
SELECT circuitref FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE NOT dob IS NULL ORDER BY dob ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.driverref FROM races AS r JOIN results AS x ON x.raceid = r.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = x.driverid WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2007 AND x.positionorder = 1
SELECT name FROM races WHERE raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM results WHERE rank = 1 AND driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton'))

SELECT t2.fastestlapspeed FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid WHERE t1.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND t1.year = 2009 AND NOT t2.fastestlapspeed IS NULL ORDER BY t2.fastestlapspeed DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT t2.positionorder FROM races AS t1 INNER JOIN results AS t2 ON t2.raceid = t1.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t3.driverid = t2.driverid WHERE t3.forename = 'Lewis' AND t3.surname = 'Hamilton' AND t1.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND t1.year = 2008
SELECT x.time FROM results AS x JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008 AND x.positionorder = 2

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT t1.driverid FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE t2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND t2.year = 2008 AND t1.time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t1.driverid HAVING COUNT(t2.raceid) > 0) AS subquery

columns: (CAST((SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100) / (SELECT time_seconds + (SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) FROM champion_time)

postgresql.sql: WITH time_in_seconds AS (SELECT t1.positionorder, CASE WHEN t1.positionorder = 1 THEN (CAST(SUBSTRING(t1.time FROM 1 FOR 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(t1.time FROM 3 FOR 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60) + CAST(SUBSTRING(t1.time FROM 6) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE CAST(SUBSTRING(t1.time FROM 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS time_seconds FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE t2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND NOT t1.time IS NULL AND t2.year = 2008), champion_time AS (SELECT time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionorder = 1), last_driver_incremental AS (SELECT time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionorder = (SELECT MAX(positionorder) FROM time_in_seconds)) SELECT (CAST((SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100) / NULLIF((SELECT time_seconds + (SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) FROM champion_time), 0)
SELECT COUNT(circuitid) FROM circuits WHERE location = 'Adelaide' AND country = 'Australia'
SELECT MAX(t1.points) FROM constructorstandings AS t1 INNER JOIN constructors AS t2 ON t1.constructorid = t2.constructorid WHERE t2.nationality = 'British'
SELECT t2.name FROM constructorstandings AS t1 INNER JOIN constructors AS t2 ON t1.constructorid = t2.constructorid WHERE t1.points = 0 AND t1.raceid = 291

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT s.constructorid FROM constructorstandings AS s JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorid = s.constructorid WHERE s.points = 0 AND c.nationality = 'Japanese' GROUP BY s.constructorid HAVING COUNT(s.raceid) = 2) AS eligible

columns: CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.time IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / COUNT(T1.raceId)

postgresql.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t1.time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(t1.raceid), 0) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid INNER JOIN drivers AS t3 ON t1.driverid = t3.driverid WHERE t3.nationality = 'Japanese' AND t2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

WITH time_in_seconds AS (SELECT t2.year, t2.raceid, t1.positionorder, CASE WHEN t1.positionorder = 1 THEN (CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(t1.time, ':', 1) <> '' AND SPLIT_PART(t1.time, ':', 2) <> '' AND SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(t1.time, ':', 3), '.', 1) <> '' THEN (CAST(SPLIT_PART(t1.time, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 3600) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(t1.time, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60) + CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(t1.time, ':', 3), '.', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) + CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(t1.time, ':', 3), '.', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t1.time FROM 2) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t1.time FROM 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE 0 END) END AS time_seconds FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE t1.time IS NOT NULL AND t1.time <> ''), champion_time AS (SELECT year, raceid, time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionorder = 1) SELECT year, AVG(time_seconds) FROM champion_time WHERE year < 1975 GROUP BY year HAVING AVG(time_seconds) IS NOT NULL
SELECT t1.fastestlap FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE t2.year = 2009 AND t1.time LIKE '_:%:__.___'

SELECT CAST(value AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS value FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t1.fastestlapspeed AS DECIMAL)) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid WHERE t2.year = 2009 AND t2.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix') AS measured(value)

columns: CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y',d.dob) AS INTEGER)<1985 AND x.laps>50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)*100/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)

postgresql.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) < 1985 AND x.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM results AS x JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = x.driverid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) FROM drivers AS d JOIN laptimes AS l ON l.driverid = d.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'French' AND (CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 3) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 3600 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 3) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) WHEN SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 2) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE CAST(l.time AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) < 120
SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American'

WITH ranked AS (SELECT code, nationality, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dob DESC, driverid) AS n FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL), top3 AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE n <= 3) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN code END) AS code1, MAX(CASE WHEN n = 2 THEN code END) AS code2, MAX(CASE WHEN n = 3 THEN code END) AS code3, SUM(CASE WHEN nationality = 'Dutch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dutch_count FROM top3
SELECT driverref FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT d.driverid, d.code FROM results AS x JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = x.driverid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) = 1971 AND x.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM results WHERE statusid = 2 AND raceid < 100 AND raceid > 50
WITH venues AS (SELECT DISTINCT location, lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Austria') SELECT COUNT(*) OVER () AS venue_count, location, lat, lng FROM venues ORDER BY location, lat, lng

SELECT t3.year, t3.name, t3.date, t3.time FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t1.driverid = t2.driverid INNER JOIN races AS t3 ON t1.raceid = t3.raceid WHERE t1.driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) ORDER BY t3.date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM pitstops AS p JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = p.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.duration, ':', 3) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.duration, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 3600 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.duration, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.duration, ':', 3) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.duration, ':', 2) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.duration, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.duration, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE CAST(p.duration AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END), d.driverid LIMIT 3

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, x.time FROM results AS x JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = x.driverid WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008 AND x.positionorder = 1

SELECT t3.constructorref, t3.url FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid INNER JOIN constructors AS t3 ON t1.constructorid = t3.constructorid WHERE t2.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND t2.year = 2009 AND t1.time LIKE '_:%:__.___'

SELECT SUM(t1.points), t2.name, t2.nationality FROM constructorresults AS t1 INNER JOIN constructors AS t2 ON t1.constructorid = t2.constructorid INNER JOIN races AS t3 ON t3.raceid = t1.raceid WHERE t3.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND t3.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY t2.name, t2.nationality ORDER BY SUM(t1.points) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t2.forename, t2.surname FROM qualifying AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers AS t2 ON t1.driverid = t2.driverid INNER JOIN races AS t3 ON t1.raceid = t3.raceid WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND t3.year = 2008 AND t3.circuitid IN (SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit') ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT_PART(q3, ':', 1) AS INT) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(q3, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) + CAST(SPLIT_PART(q3, '.', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000 ASC LIMIT 1

WITH youngest AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC, driverid LIMIT 1) SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, r.name FROM youngest AS d JOIN driverstandings AS s ON s.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = s.raceid ORDER BY r.date, r.round, r.raceid LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(t1.driverid) FROM results AS t1 INNER JOIN races AS t2 ON t1.raceid = t2.raceid INNER JOIN status AS t3 ON t1.statusid = t3.statusid WHERE t3.statusid = 3 AND t2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' GROUP BY t1.driverid ORDER BY COUNT(t1.driverid) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

WITH minimums AS (SELECT l.driverid, MIN(CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 3) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 3600 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 3) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) WHEN SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 2) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(l.time, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE CAST(l.time AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) AS seconds FROM laptimes AS l GROUP BY l.driverid) SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM minimums AS m JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverid = m.driverid ORDER BY m.seconds, d.driverid LIMIT 20

WITH ranked AS (SELECT c.circuitid, c.name, x.fastestlaptime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.circuitid ORDER BY (CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(x.fastestlaptime, ':', 3) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(x.fastestlaptime, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 3600 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(x.fastestlaptime, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(x.fastestlaptime, ':', 3) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) WHEN SPLIT_PART(x.fastestlaptime, ':', 2) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(x.fastestlaptime, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(x.fastestlaptime, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE CAST(x.fastestlaptime AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END), r.date, r.raceid, x.resultid) AS n FROM results AS x JOIN races AS r ON r.raceid = x.raceid JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE c.country = 'Italy' AND x.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL) SELECT circuitid, name, fastestlaptime AS lap_record FROM ranked WHERE n = 1 ORDER BY circuitid
